Team —

Wrapping up the sales side for Pertinent Health (deal RDW-2026-8882). They signed last week and Procurements expects a kickoff week of Oct 18–22. Key context below; please take ownership of onboarding activities starting with the kick-off call we agreed to on Oct 14.

Quick context:
- Use case: integrated LLM-assisted clinical coding and clinical documentation summarization (PHI-segregated pipeline; Private deployment requested).
- Committed start: Nov 1 for pilot (3-month pilot, 2 seats + API throughput for 200 concurrent users during daytime window).
- Primary contacts: Amelia Carter (Product Lead) and Liam O'Neill (IT/Procurement).

Immediate asks for CS owner:
1) Confirm internal owner for kickoff and send calendar invite for Oct 14, 10:00–11:00 PT.
2) Review attached SOW (PertinentHealth_SOW_v1.2.pdf) and call out any redline concerns by EOD Oct 13.
3) Validate the implementation timeline (attached) and identify any resource gaps (infra, SE support, privacy review).

Attachments: PertinentHealth_SOW_v1.2.pdf, PertinentHealth_Implementation_Timeline.xlsx, Kickoff_Agenda_20261014.docx

I'll join the kickoff to support handoff and cover negotiated items. Marissa — can you own the kickoff and the initial 30/60/90 onboarding plan? Dev — can you confirm we have SE time allocated the week of Oct 25 for the infra checklist?

Thanks,

--

Marissa — forwarded to SE scheduling. Short answer: yes, we have a two-day window on Oct 26–27 that I can reserve for the initial infra validation. I'll slot an SE (internal alias: infra_se_team) and block Sep- Oct 26 in my calendar.

A couple of technical notes from the pre-sales thread that will help you prep:
- Pertinent wants Private deployment in their AWS account with KMS-managed keys. Expect at least one network review and a temporary bastion for setup.
- They requested token-level audit logs and 12-month retention — confirm with security and include in runbook.
- Model variant: start pilot on quantized Llama2-70B variant for cost; we agreed to fallback to an LLM-Large variant if latency exceeds 250ms P95.
